paper.title_en: A Generalized Class of Taub-NUT-Scalar Metrics
paper.abstract_en: We consider a class of three-parameter metrics that was introduced in \cite{azizallahi2024three}. The class of metrics contain Zipoy-Voorhees (ZV) and Fisher-Janis-Newman- Winicour (FJNW) spacetimes at certain values of the parameters. We build an axially symmetric and asymptotically flat spacetime with gravitomagnetic effects by introducing a Newman- Unti-Tamburino (NUT) charge into this class of metrics via the Ehlers transformation. We investigate the physical features of this class of Taub-NUT-scalar (TNS) metrics including gravitational lensing, quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra, and test particle motion. Our results provide fresh insight on how mass, multipole moments, and gravitomagnetic fields behave in the presence of a scalar field and show the effect of the NUT charge on stability of orbits in this class of metrics.

decision.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了一类三参数度量，该类度量在\cite{azizallahi2024three}中被引入。这类度量在参数取特定值时包含Zipoy-Voorhees (ZV)和Fisher-Janis-Newman-Winicour (FJNW)时空。我们通过Ehlers变换将Newman-Unti-Tamburino (NUT)电荷引入该类度量，构建了一个具有引力磁效应的轴对称且渐近平坦的时空。我们研究了这类Taub-NUT-标量(TNS)度量的物理特征，包括引力透镜、准正则模式(QNM)谱和测试粒子运动。我们的结果为在存在标量场时质量、多极矩和引力磁场的表现提供了新的见解，并展示了NUT电荷对此类度量中轨道稳定性的影响。
